name: pw-browser
description: Playwright-based browser automation CLI (daemon + client) driving your system Chrome/Edge. INCLUDES HIGH-RISK PRIMITIVES: direct cookie/localStorage credential extraction & injection (session tokens), arbitrary in-page JavaScript (eval), and daemon-context code execution (run-code) — plus a persistent credentialed session. Gated by a random daemon token; set PW_BROWSER_SAFE_MODE=1 to disable all code-exec and credential primitives. Authorize only in trusted, user-visible local environments.
author: Yicko

scripts.test: node tests/smoke.js && node tests/features.js && node tests/a-group.js && node tests/b-negative.js && node tests/c-snapcap.js && node tests/d-download.js
